svg.title: Anthropic expands its cyber verification program; defensive teams should first check their access level
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Anthropic expands its cyber verification program;
defensive teams should first check their access level
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-19
First check which of the three levels
covers your work
The first level is Defense Access.
Check the data-retention conditions
before applying
Organizations enrolled in the CVP must retain
data so that abuse can be monitored.
Separate what continues to work and
what is blocked on general models
According to the company’s guidance, general
models can still be used for code reviews,
patching known vulnerabilities, finding…
What was not confirmed in the
announcement
First, Anthropic determines whether an
application is approved and how long processing
takes.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
